messages.subject: First Renjin newsletter is out!
parts:
Hi all,

in case you're not subscribed to the Renjin newsletter: you can read the first issue at http://eepurl.com/byDtNP. We plan to send the newsletter out at least a couple of times a year so subscribe if you'd like to receive these in your mailbox in the future.

Maarten-Jan
